description: This file defines a Java class 'MessageNativeCodeProducer' responsible for generating native code (C header and source files) related to IPC messages in a code generation framework. It handles creation of code headers, function declarations, implementations, and handler headers for client and service sides, specifically for IPC message handling in native code (C).

classes.name: MessageNativeCodeProducer
classes.description: A class responsible for generating native C code (headers and source files) for IPC messages, including functions and handlers, in a code generation framework.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Orchestrates the overall code generation process, producing message code headers, function headers, bodies for client and service, using templates and message data.

methods.name: generateWrapperFile
methods.description: Indicates that wrapper files are not generated for native messages.

methods.name: generateWrapperBuffer
methods.description: Returns null as wrapper buffers are not applicable for native messages.

methods.name: generateCodesHeader
methods.description: Creates the IPC codes header file for both client and service, defining message codes.

methods.name: generateClientFunctionsHeader
methods.description: Creates the header file with function declarations for client-side IPC message calls.

methods.name: generateClientFunctionsBody
methods.description: Creates the source (.c) file with implementations of IPC request functions for the client.

methods.name: generateServiceFunctionsHeader
methods.description: Creates the handler header file with function declarations for service-side message handlers.

methods.name: generateServiceFunctionsBody
methods.description: Creates the source (.c) file with implementations for message handlers on the service side.

methods.name: combineIncludes
methods.description: Utility method to combine and sort include headers into a cohesive include section.
